title: Scaffold prints the empty-files warning when every candidate source is owned by another spec
description: scaffold prints the empty-files warning when every candidate source is owned by another spec
no_spec_change_rationale: REQ-cmd-scaffold-006 AC2 already requires files: [] plus the empty-files warning when no unowned candidate is left; scaffold omitted the warning, and this change makes the code match the existing requirement
acceptance_criteria: scaffold foo, where every candidate source file is already listed by another spec, writes files: [] and prints the same empty-files warning on stderr that new prints; the scaffold, single-source-fallback and new ownership integration tests assert files: [] and that warning

answers.constraints: an existing spec is never overwritten (cmd_scaffold context); the warning text matches new's so both commands report the no-files path the same way
